people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

people.name: Micah
people.line: A man from Ephraim who set up idolatrous worship.

translations.web: There was a man of the hill country of Ephraim, whose name was Micah.
translations.bsb: Now a man named Micah from the hill country of Ephraim
translations.kjv: And there was a man of mount Ephraim, whose name was Micah.
translations.asv: And there was a man of the hill-country of Ephraim, whose name was Micah.
